user.title: Connect your Deye inverter
user.description: Read-only local readings for the SUN SG0xLP1 family. Link2 Modbus TCP must already be enabled on the logger. Positive grid power means import; positive battery power means discharge.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the logger. Check its IP, port and Link2 Modbus TCP setting.
error.unsupported_device: The inverter identity or register profile did not match. Only SG0xLP1 is supported.
